messages:
Maria Gonzales: Quick sync — we need a model card update for zephyr-mini-4b-quant. Current card says max seq 2048 but runtime supports 4096 when quant-profile=v2. Can docs PR also add a streaming compatibility note and an SDK snippet showing embedding fallback?

Ashok Patel: yup, quant-profile v2 extends context to 4096 but with ~1.2x memory. Benchmarks available. I'll paste numbers in a sec.

Sophie Lee: @Maria can you list exact places in the card to change? limits table, compatibility section, and the sample code block for clients. Also we should add a short note about slight perf regressions on tail latency for 4096 sequences.

Maria Gonzales: places: 1) "limits" table (max_sequence_length) 2) "compatibility" -> streaming + kv-cache note 3) example snippets (python/ts) 4) migration link to /docs/migrations/quant-profiles

Ashok Patel: Benchmarks (on p4d):
```
model: zephyr-mini-4b-quant (quant-profile=v2)
input_len: 4096
throughput: 85 tokens/sec/pod
p95 latency (single request, 1 tok gen): 420ms
p99 latency: 980ms
```
Note: for 2048 seq throughput ~140 tok/s, p99 ~680ms. Will upload CSV to the bench bucket.

Tanner Wu: Runtime note — streaming is fine but kv-cache prefetch needs `enable_kv_compaction=true` for quant v2 to avoid repeated recompute on rollbacks. Please add this snippet in compatibility:
```
# curl example for streaming call with kv compaction
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
 -d '{"model":"zephyr-mini-4b-quant","input":"hello","runtime_options":{"enable_kv_compaction":true}}'
```
This prevents OOM in long prefix cases.

Li Huang: For SDK snippet, suggest showing async streaming + fallback to hosted embeddings when CPU fallback occurs. Draft python snippet:
```
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=...)
# streaming with low-precision hint
with client.stream("zephyr-mini-4b-quant", use_low_precision=True) as s:
    for chunk in s:
        print(chunk.text)
# embeddings fallback
emb = client.embeddings.create(model="zephyr-mini-4b-quant", input="...", embedding_mode="hybrid")
```
Add comment that hybrid mode will route to hosted embedding pipeline if local quantized path can't meet accuracy.

Sophie Lee: Perfect. I'll draft the PR with edits to limits table, add the kv-cache note, and include both python and TS snippets. Also will add a short callout in migration guide about tokenizer compatibility (zephyr v2 tokenizer has new EOS behavior).

Maria Gonzales: Heads-up: old link in catalog points to /models/zephyr-mini-4b which 302s -> /models/zephyr/mini-4b. Need to make sure new card uses canonical link to avoid broken anchors.

deploy-bot: PR opened by @Sophie Lee: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4722 — includes bench CSV and updated snippets :rocket:

Sophie Lee: assigning reviewers @Ashok, @Tanner, @Li. Also pinging QA for sample validation.

qa-bot: Checklist for PR #4722:
- [ ] limits table updated
- [ ] streaming compatibility note + curl snippet
- [ ] SDK python + TS snippets included
- [ ] migration guide link added
- [ ] bench CSV attached
- [ ] canonical model URL fixed
Please add test vectors under docs/samples/zephyr-mini-4b/ for CI validation.

Ashok Patel: I'll review bench numbers and confirm CSV. If perf looks good I'll approve.

Tanner Wu: I'll verify the kv-cache note with runtime team. If runtime needs a config flag change, we'll coordinate a short release note.

Li Huang: I'll add the TS snippet and a small unit test for the streaming example in devex/snippets.

Maria Gonzales: Thanks all — tagging this as priority for this sprint since customers hit the 4096 mismatch. :thumbsup:

Sophie Lee: I'll merge after approvals and leave a follow-up to add a small note to the catalog release notes.
